subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu plugin send message fails with 400 error - receive_id_type is required

question: Should maintainers require a current-main Feishu/Lark live send diagnostic before reviving or replacing the conflicting fork PR for this issue?
rationale: The source path is suspicious but inconclusive: current code passes `receive_id_type`, the reporter's manual API call also failed, and the open closing PR is conflicting and lacks proof.

options.title: Require fresh Feishu proof
options.body: Ask for a latest-release or current-main Feishu send log with vendor code and log_id before adopting or replacing the linked PR.

options.title: Adopt a repaired PR path
